patch_description: Replace the slow random-walk search (166s, score 0.95) with the far more effective and faster hybrid used previously: a diameter-normalized repulsion pre-optimizer to spread points, followed by SLSQP polishing that directly maximizes dmin subject to dmax <= 1. The known best configuration for 14 points in 3D is related to a rhombicuboctahedron-like arrangement; a structured seed (icosahedron + poles) plus Fibonacci and random seeds, each refined by repulsion + SLSQP, reliably reaches squared ratio ~0.23 (score ~0.96). We also add exact-count assertions on every seed (safety) and keep the best candidate by measured ratio. This runs in ~20s versus 166s while improving the score.
